demo_scenarios.description: 7+ distinct accounts funneling funds to a single collector account within brief intervals.
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Target account risk score >= 40.0 with high in-degree ratio.

demo_scenarios.name: Fan-Out Dispersion Hub
demo_scenarios.description: Single primary source dispersing high volumes across multiple receiver accounts.
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Target account risk score >= 40.0 with high out-degree ratio.

demo_scenarios.name: Rapid Passthrough Movement
demo_scenarios.description: Immediate forwarding (95% of incoming funds forwarded within 5 minutes).
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Fastest latency: ~300 seconds; high passthrough ratio.

demo_scenarios.name: Multi-Hop Transaction Chain
demo_scenarios.description: Sequential linear chain across 5 connected accounts (A -> B -> C -> D -> E).
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Chain length 4+ verified with fee deduction pattern.

demo_scenarios.name: Circular Layering Loop
demo_scenarios.description: Closed directed cycle (A -> B -> C -> A) returning funds to originating entity.
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Cycle participation confirmed by Tarjan/Johnson cycle detection.

demo_scenarios.name: Coordinated Account Cluster
demo_scenarios.description: Dense interconnected group of accounts transacting heavily among themselves.
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Strongly connected component with high internal density.

demo_scenarios.name: Structured Transfers
demo_scenarios.description: Five transfers of 9,400-9,950 within a few hours, each kept just under the 10,000 threshold.
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: 3+ near-threshold transfers inside 24 hours flag both splitter and collector.

demo_scenarios.name: Mule-Ring (MFS Money-Mule Network)
demo_scenarios.description: 8 feeder wallets -> collector hub -> 4 mule wallets -> cash-out agent -> back to the hub, all within about two hours.
demo_scenarios.benchmark_note: Fan-in, structuring, rapid movement, chain and a time-ordered loop combine into a CRITICAL score.
